items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued October 11 at 11:35AM EDT until October 11 at 6:00PM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 7
to 8 feet expected in the surf zone. For the Beach Hazards
Statement, a high risk of rip currents is expected.

* WHERE...Maryland Beaches, including Ocean City.

* WHEN...For the High Surf Advisory, until 6 PM EDT this
evening. For the Beach Hazards Statement, until 8 PM EDT this
evening.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 11 at 10:33AM EDT until October 11 at 4:00PM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...East to southeast winds 25 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and
seas 7 to 10 ft expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Fenwick Island DE to Chincoteague
VA out 20 NM, Coastal waters from Chincoteague to Parramore
Island VA out 20 NM, Waters from Fenwick Island DE to
Chintoteague VA from 20 to 60 NM and Waters from Chincoteague
VA to Parramore Island VA from 20 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM EDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
